name: Lead Management — Google Forms API (private local)

parameters.jsCode:
const state = $getWorkflowStaticData('global');
return [{ json: { form_id: 'REPLACE_WITH_PRIVATE_GOOGLE_FORM_ID', last_submitted_time: state.lastSubmittedTime || null, run_mode: 'DRY_RUN' } }];

parameters.url: ={{ 'https://forms.googleapis.com/v1/forms/' + $('Read cursor and form config').first().json.form_id + '/responses?pageSize=500' + ($('Read cursor and form config').first().json.last_submitted_time ? '&filter=' + encodeURIComponent('timestamp >= ' + $('Read cursor and form config').first().json.last_submitted_time) : '') }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { payload: { form_id: $json.form_id, form: $json.form, response: $json.response }, context: { workflow_id: 'lead_management_google_forms_api', attempt: 1, mode: $json.run_mode } } }}
